'''Fandar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was known as the "[[Pirate/Legends|Pirate]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]]."

==Biography==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Fandar was a notorious [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who ranked at number six on the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Imperial Most Wanted List|most-wanted list]]. Known as the "[[Pirate/Legends|Pirate]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]]", he had a number of loyal [[retainer]]s. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[operative]]s tried to meet with Fandar to enlist his services in harassing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] shipping. Fandar held no interest in [[Politics/Legends|politics]], and the Alliance wasn't offering the kind of [[Currency/Legends|money]] he wanted, but he struck a deal; if they helped to raid an Imperial [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]] he would discuss future dealings.<ref name="Prince" />

[[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] approved the endeavour, but during the raid, Fandar was betrayed by [[Fandar's right-hand man|his own second-in-command]] when the treasure [[Starship/Legends|ship]] turned out to be full of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] rather than treasure. Fandar and the Rebels escaped the Imperial trap, and Fandar initially thought the Rebels had sold him out. When he discovered his own [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] had betrayed him, Fandar thanked the Rebels for their assistance, renounced his piratical ways, and joined the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] as a Captain.<ref name="Prince" />
